name: Old Selsey
notes: Designated by Cabinet on 5 September 2017 (item 409, resolution 3: 'a new conservation area Old Selsey be designated to cover parts of East Street and Albion Road'); an earlier decision of 4 October 2016 was deferred. Updated appraisal approved by Cabinet on 2 December 2025. Geometry: the unnamed feature 80 of the council's AllMaps WFS layer (no PDP or Historic England geometry covers it; the council's INSPIRE layer does not hold it).
